newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Bids and demand mixed.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Bids and demand mixed.

text.p: Dark northern spring wheat bids were mixed on Tuesday with some areas quoting higher basis bids amid scattered interest from terminal elevators, several cash grain merchants said.

"There seems to be a little demand kicking around from terminals, and farmers are slow to move anything," a Minnesota merchant said. Basis levels there rose roughly six cents, bringing cash bids up a nickel.
But cash bids were lower in parts of North Dakota and Montana, in line with slightly lower MGE futures.
Weather continued to be of concern to farmers.
Fields in the Red River Valley received some moisture over the weekend which aided in germination but slowed planting. To the west, fields were still in need of moisture.
"The farmers are kind of concerned about the stuff they just planted because of the dry weather," one dealer said. "We could use a good drenching rain to get the crop off to a good start."
